original_title: The 10 Most Expensive Welcome To Night City Cards In The Cyberpunk TCG
summary_en: The Cyberpunk TCG's "Welcome to Night City" set has exploded onto the scene, and some of its rarest cards are already fetching staggering prices. Discover which iconic characters and moments are commanding top dollar in this competitive card game.
ai_analysis: The immense value of these cards highlights the passionate player base and the deep connection fans have to the Cyberpunk universe, driving collector demand.

en.title: The 10 Most Expensive Cards in Cyberpunk TCG's "Welcome to Night City"
en.summary: The Cyberpunk TCG's "Welcome to Night City" set has exploded onto the scene, and some of its rarest cards are already fetching staggering prices. Discover which iconic characters and moments are commanding top dollar in this competitive card game.
en.body:
## 1. Sasha Yakov Lever (Secret Rare)
This iconic secret rare version of Sasha Yakov Lever currently holds the top spot as the most expensive card in the retail "Welcome to Night City" set. As of November 7, 2026, it's valued at a staggering $1,595, showcasing its extreme desirability among collectors and players alike.

## 2. Panam Palmer - Strength Through Family (Secret Rare)
Following closely behind is the secret rare "Strength Through Family" card featuring the fan-favorite Panam Palmer. Valued at $1,371.28, this card represents a powerful moment for the character and is a significant chase item for anyone looking to build a top-tier deck or complete their collection.

## 3. Johnny Silverhand - Rocking Renegade (Secret Rare)
The first of the four secret iconic rare cards, "Rocking Renegade" featuring Johnny Silverhand, commands a hefty $716.56. This card captures the rebellious spirit of the legendary rockerboy, making it a must-have for its thematic relevance and rarity.

## 4. Judy Alvarez - 'Cause I'm a Star (Secret Rare)
While specific pricing fluctuates, Judy Alvarez's "'Cause I'm a Star" secret rare card is a highly sought-after piece from the "Welcome to Night City" set. Its value is driven by Judy's popularity and the card's unique artwork, making it a key target for collectors.

## 5. Goro Takemura - Loyal Retainer (Secret Rare)
Goro Takemura, the stoic Arasaka loyalist, also has a secret rare card that is climbing in value. "Loyal Retainer" is prized for its representation of a pivotal character and the intricate design typical of the rarest TCG cards.

## 6. Rogue Amendiares - The Queen of Street (Secret Rare)
Rogue Amendiares, the formidable fixer, is immortalized in a secret rare version of her card. Its high value is a testament to her status as a major player in Night City and the demand for her powerful presence on the tabletop.

## 7. Jackie Welles - Street Kid (Iconic Rare)
Even beyond the secret rares, iconic rare cards like "Street Kid" featuring Jackie Welles are highly valuable. This card captures the early days of the protagonist's journey and is a significant draw for players who connect with Jackie's story.

## 8. V - Corpo (Iconic Rare)
The "Corpo" version of V, representing one of the starting lifepaths, is another iconic rare card with significant market value. It appeals to players who enjoy the corporate intrigue and the unique gameplay associated with this background.

## 9. V - Nomad (Iconic Rare)
Similarly, the "Nomad" iconic rare card for V holds considerable value. Its appeal lies in the wild, untamed spirit of the Badlands and the distinct playstyle it enables, making it a popular choice for collectors.

## 10. Dexter DeShawn - A Deal's a Deal (Iconic Rare)
Dexter DeShawn, the notorious ripperdoc and fixer, is represented by the "A Deal's a Deal" iconic rare card. Its value is tied to his role in kicking off the main storyline of Cyberpunk 2077, making it a thematically important and collectible piece.
Bottom Line: The "Welcome to Night City" TCG is already seeing immense collector interest, with secret rare cards of key characters like Sasha Yakov Lever and Panam Palmer leading the charge in market value.

content_raw: Earlier this year, WeirdCo opened its official Kickstarter for the Cyberpunk Trading Card Game. Within hours, it broke multiple records on the crowdfunding website , raising over $28 million. It draws on the world of CD Projekt Red's Cyberpunk 2077, with players building decks and assembling edgerunner crews featuring fan-favorite characters.
